newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts Xerox EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts Xerox EPS view.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Jonathan Rosenzweig lowered his earnings estimates on Xerox Corp for 1996 and 1997 after the company's announcement last Friday of weaker than expected third quarter earnings.
-- Cut fourth quarter estimate to $1.13 per share from $1.26 and full year estimate to $3.28 from $3.55.
-- Maintained buy rating, with 12-month price target of $56.
-- cited solid growth of digital and color product lines and a belief that Xerox "is committed to controlling SG&A costs and that margins will expand significantly next year."

-- said shares "could remain a bit sluggish near-term as growth-oriented investors abandon the shares," but predicted a solid fourth quarter and said the sale of Xerox's Talegen units would provide the catalyst needed to renew momentum.
